command: cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | head -60; which mcpjam npx; env | grep -c MCPJAM
cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/overview.md | head -80; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/local-evals.md | head -120

cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1; M="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"; $M server probe --url http://fixture:8765/mcp 2>&1 | tail -20; $M tools list --url http://fixture:8765/mcp 2>&1 | head -50

cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1; M="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"
$M tools call --url http://fixture:8765/mcp --tool-name add --tool-args '{"a":2,"b":3}' 2>&1 | head -20
mkdir -p .mcpjam/evals
cat > .mcp.json <<'E'
{"mcpServers":{"arith":{"type":"http","url":"http://fixture:8765/mcp"}}}
E
cat > .mcpjam/evals/arith.yaml <<'E'
schemaVersion: "2"
mode: agentWorkflow
reportingMode: standard
suite:
  id: s_arith
  name: Arithmetic fixture
target:
  servers:
    - name: arith
defaults:
  judge:
    enabled: false
  model: anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5
  iterations: 1
  passThreshold: 1
  validity: {}
cases:
  - id: c_adds
    title: uses add for a sum
    steps:
      - id: s1
        kind: prompt
        prompt: What is 17 plus 25? Use the tool.
      - id: a1
        kind: assert
        assertion:
          type: toolCalledAtLeastOnce
          toolName: add
E
$M cloud eval validate --file .mcpjam/evals/arith.yaml 2>&1 | tail -10
$M test --help 2>&1 | grep -iE "hosted|inference|api-key|project|reporter" | head

cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1; M="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"
$M test .mcpjam/evals/arith.yaml --inference mcpjam --project project_fixture --reporter junit-xml --out reports/arith.xml 2>&1 | tail -30; echo exit=$?
cd /workspace; env | grep -ciE "ANTHROPIC|OPENAI"; export MCPJAM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1; npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest cloud whoami 2>&1 | head -5

cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1; npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest test .mcpjam/evals/arith.yaml --inference byok --project project_fixture --reporter junit-xml --out reports/arith.xml 2>&1 | tail -15
